notes: Lazygit-style git pane (stash, discard, remotes, modals, command log). Project-wide search streams results and supports find/replace. Rundeck pane shows projects as upstream returns them; execution watcher pauses when you tab away. Settings is now a full pane, not a modal. Terminal startup waits for the shell's first byte instead of a 350ms timer. Internals: full async PTY (less memory per hidden agent), tokio for CloudWatch log tails, typed Rust errors end-to-end, immer for store mutations.
